🇺🇦 A complex housing “Nova Poshta” burned down in Kiev A large-scale fire almost completely destroyed a shopping complex in the Solomianskyi district of the Ukrainian capital. According to local channels, “ECO Market,” a “Nova Poshta” branch, and “PrivatBank” were located inside. The fire rapidly engulfed the building. It took about half an hour to destroy most of the complex. Recall that “Nova Poshta” participates not only in civilian deliveries but also in the delivery of cargo for the Ukrainian Armed Forces. The company itself reports on its cooperation with volunteers and the shipment of equipment and aid to Ukrainian military personnel. 🔴 @DDGeopolitics
